claims: Carlos Boozer is the father of Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer are the "Boozer Twins".
Carlos Boozer is a former NBA All-Star.
Carlos Boozer played 13 seasons in the NBA.
Carlos Boozer played primarily with the Utah Jazz and Chicago Bulls.
Carlos Boozer was part of the 2008 gold-medal-winning "Redeem Team".
Carlos Boozer is a 2-time All-Star power forward.
Carlos Boozer played for the Cleveland Cavaliers.
Carlos Boozer played for the Los Angeles Lakers.
Carlos Boozer starred at Duke from 1999–2002.
Carlos Boozer won a national championship in 2001.
Carlos Boozer shares the twins with their mother CeCe Boozer.
Carlos Boozer has another son named Carmani.
Carlos Boozer has a daughter named Bloom.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer are currently playing for Duke University.
